description: This file contains build definitions, custom build rules, and device configurations for building Chromium-based images for a Google WiFi device. It defines build steps such as copying and packaging kernel images, signing the bootloader, and device-specific parameters.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build rule to copy a file to a temporary location, generate a GPT partition table, and append it to the original image.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Build rule to append the kernel partition to the image using dd with specified block size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Build rule to sign the kernel image using cros-vbutil tool, inserting the correct root partition UUID.
